ForceDuoApp
Force iPhone Duo's application use latest SDK to adaptive and supports iPhone Duo, normally it just fall back to iPad UI

 [!WARNING]
 worse query got patched on 27.3 beta 2 so it won’t work anymore if you updated to 27.3b2. iOS 27.2.1 still safe!

 Story
I actually do it myself on Genshin Impact by using this bug (worse query) already for a while, check this!

Then the bug (worse query got burned by forcequit, yeah, i also found it on Aug too :P) and I think it's a time to release how to do it and then i saw someone do the app with automatically patch instead of doing it by my deadass old school way, check the original post here

So this is the release post!
Demo (Apple Store app now support iPhone Duo)!
